# Test fixtures

Raw responses from the Guild Wars 2 wiki's API (`api.php?action=ask`), captured on 2026-11-15 to test the parsers in `src/wiki.ts`:

- `wiki-mystic-forge.json`: Mystic Forge recipes for Gift of Mastery and Mystic Clover.
- `wiki-vendor-offers.json`: vendor offers for Philosopher's Stone.

These files are not covered by this repository's MIT license. Text contributed to [wiki.guildwars2.com](https://wiki.guildwars2.com) is available under the [GNU Free Documentation License 1.3](https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Guild_Wars_2_Wiki:Copyrights); game content (item, vendor and recipe names) belongs to ArenaNet. They are test data only and are not part of the published npm package.
